source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical 1367 NewsDeliveryListener call retains url, true, exitCode even though the new callback then expects isNewsDelivery first, and its news forwarding branch omits serverURI. Accepted code uses serverURI, exitCode, secInfo, errMsg, isNewsDelivery, and NewsDeliveryListener passes url, exitCode, null, null, true. This source comparison shows a dated argument-order hazard, not a reproduced news failure. When changing this callback, trace each protocol caller and forwarding branch together. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: News and mail delivery callbacks require argument-order checks across interface changes
